title: koellia lanceolata
intro: Koellia lanceolata, commonly known as Koellia, is a type of flowering plant native to South Africa. The health benefits of Koellia lanceolata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Koellia lanceolata include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Koellia lanceolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
